description: Claim set for multi-tenant B2B SaaS / AI-agent platforms: isolation and authorization semantics first — the classes pattern tools cannot test. Adopt claims individually with fv-claims add; this file documents the recommended set and ordering.
notes: Start with the hyper claims (ISO-001, AUTHZ-004): they require differential probe evidence, so wire fv-probe's dual-tenant campaign first.
AUTHZ-009 (context before auth) is the choke most multi-app backends get wrong; model it with tenant_isolation's hint adversary.
